honest_C3_disclosures: Detector is conservative-honest — flags 'empty', 'too_short' (<10 chars), 'prompt_echo', 'token_spam' (>50% mass on 1 token), and known refusal patterns. Does NOT detect semantic factual hallucination (e.g. wrong-but-fluent answers).

3 of 20 prompts produced empty completions on base Mistral-7B-v0.3 (id 5 emotion, 15 roleplay, 19 meta) — base model lacks Korean coverage on certain prompt classes; the p4_r8 LoRA is precisely the layer trained to remedy this — but the LoRA is broken (truncation), so this rate is upper bound on the BASE-floor.
PASS at 15% (under 30% threshold) is meaningful for the alpha invite-tier infrastructure verdict, but is NOT a verdict on the trained adapter quality.
Re-measure required after p4_r8 adapter re-training.
